Love Letter

My love,

Happy anniversary. If I could bottle up everything I feel about us, I think it would look a lot like this page — a collection of moments that seem small on their own, but together became something I never want to take for granted.

Thank you for every laugh, every adventure, every ordinary day that felt warmer because you were there. Thank you for letting me know you, grow with you, and keep choosing you.

I hope the next chapters hold more firsts, more inside jokes, more places we have not seen yet, and a thousand quiet moments that feel like home.

Happy anniversary. I love you — in the exciting moments, in the boring ones, and in all the moments still waiting for us.

Forever yours,
Sean
